items.title: Edwin "Squirrel" Ashcraft Interview, 1961-08-16
items.q: I'm not sure whether Petrillo was in them, but the, but the, the, the, the white union was, was pretty effective.

ctx.x: And the, the, the joints were joints and there was no other way of describing them. Some of them were fancier than others, but you were still working, uh, for what was then a pretty darn good rate of pay. I'm not sure whether Petrillo was in them, but the, but the, the, the, the white union was, was pretty effective. And in its interest in getting the weight scale up for the pit bands, which is all it was really concerned with, the large mass of fiddle players, it managed to get the scale up so much that it was…
Didn't, uh, Bill, uh, Priestley get into something of that sort, too?
